text: Exports shall record namespace, spelling, kind, type label, and value only for named constants; globals shall additionally record mutability/space/initialization mode. Alias exports shall point to resolved descriptors rather than create nominal types.
clause_basis: Conservative sentence/semicolon seed groups; semantic clause review required before closure.
